summary:

I checked the contract's seven endpoints against the backend and they are already implemented and spelled identically:

- `src/CleanArchitecture.Api/Controllers/TutorialsController.cs` — `[Route("api/tutorials")]` with GET list (with `?title=` filter), GET by id, POST, PUT, DELETE by id, DELETE all.
- `src/CleanArchitecture.Contracts/Tutorials/TutorialResponse.cs` — `Id`, `Title`, `Description`, `Published`, `CreatedAt`, `UpdatedAt`, serialized camelCase, matching the `Tutorial` model exactly.

So there was nothing to change here; I made no edits. The UI redesign items (1–4) and the Angular test updates belong to the `realworld-app-angular-v20` frontend repository.
